Overall just bad. No resolution and no apology for anything. Had to replace my entire system with another brand new system.
1. 2021 - purchased new HVAC from Garland heating and air. around 15K.
2. 2022 - electrical issue where a part was needed
3.2023 - low on refrigerant and to pay for that. Issue happened on a Sunday, they don't have 24/7 support just a phone center that notifies "someone" that I need help.
4. 2024 - evaporator coil ($4,000) needed to be replaced. I was blamed for this by 1 of the 2 women that answer the phones. I had to argue each time just to credit the service charge after paying.
5. 2025 - compressor went out and was quoted $2,500 to repair and replace. even though a tune up was done a month prior. I was advised that they just go out that's the way it is. This happened on a Sunday I called the answering service twice. No call back. I got an email at midnight, when I was sleeping that an appointment was scheduled the next day.

Had another company come out and the first thing he asked, "did I have this professional installed?" I said yes and asked why. His response was demoralizing. He said because it would have failed inspection right away having had the outside unit sitting on bricks just laying around instead of a pad. Which you can see in the pictures.
It got worse in the attic. The unit was just sitting on the ground and also sitting on bricks. There were gaps in the connections because the unit was not properly fit according to the size. The just used my old system and just attached it with putty and duct tape. The filter housing was the incorrect size so we just had wasted air leaving the system. Also in the pictures. I'll be filing a complaint with the Better Business Bureau so hopefully a future customer will think twice. I explained my frustration over the phone and the only thing I got was that they'll talk to the manager about it.
The last 4 photos are what the install should have looked like with a follow up done on the work to make sure everything is correct before the inspection is done.

Service was professional, friendly, to the point and without unnecessary marketing/upselling. The tech came in, listened to the symptoms as I described them, got to work and fixed the problem...

Last summer we called one of the commercial  HVAC companies to fix our A/C (who we see all the time on commercials) but, we called because they installed our Lennox system. They came out, couldn't find the problem and suggested that another tech might have to come out and do another level of troubleshooting for yet another charge on top of their initial outrageous service charge. Then they indicated that it might take another tech to do the repair. We were talking about 1500 to $2,000 worth of charges and three different technicians for them to potentially fix this problem. Potentially being a key word here. Here's the kicker - I suspected it was the run capacitor the whole time but they never took the time to verify if it was functioning properly -  and I informed them of this upon arrival.  It was too hot of a summer to be dealing with all that kind of nonsense so, I dismissed them, replaced the capacitor myself for about 45 bucks and it was fixed.

Today's repair which I called Garland Heating & A/C about was more complex than a capacitor replacement; and, I'm glad I called them instead of the other more high profile company. The tech didn't waste my time trying to upsell me or explain about different tiers of troubleshooting. He did all the work himself, including the repair, in timely fashion and all within the same morning. I would recommend this company over any of their major commercial competitors any day.

reviews.text: Have used these guys for a number of years, but recently charged me $387 to install a simple thermostat which took under 30 minutes. Charged me $323 for install then, a $75 diagnostic charge?...which to me should be part of the install, as in making sure it works once you install it should be part of the deal, not extra!. Now that it is still not working they are saying it likely needs a mother board as well. Also never shared a quote prior to the install, I figured it would be like $200 for the install, but not $323.00, plus the service call/diagnostic for $75. Called them to question charges, and see if they would waive the $75, but they said they would not make any adjustments to keep our business. Guess that is their business decision make, but we wont be going back...

reviews.text: The folks at Garland Heating and Air are lifesavers! A local company that is honest, trustworthy, responsive and they truly care about their customers. I came home late on a Monday to a hot house. It was already after hours but I took a chance and called anyway. The answering service took my message and shortly thereafter Andy called and I described my problem to him. He said that someone would be out the next day. The next morning (Tuesday) Ted came out went over the different options and their pros and cons. I decided on a two-stage system based on Ted’s recommendation. The next morning (Wednesday), Manny and his crew were out a little before 8am. They had the new equipment installed, inside and outside by 10am. Overall fast response and excellent service by all involved in the middle of a hot Texas summer. Thanks Garland Heating and Air!

I recently had the pleasure of experiencing top-notch service from Garland Heating and Air  and I couldn't be more delighted with the outcome. From start to finish, their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction were evident.

First and foremost, their customer service is exceptional. When I reached out to schedule an appointment for my air conditioning unit, their staff was not only friendly but also incredibly accommodating. They were able to find a convenient time slot for me, which immediately set a positive tone for my experience.

The technician who arrived at my home was punctual and courteous. They took the time to listen to my concerns and thoroughly inspected my AC system. Their knowledge and attention to detail were evident as they explained the issue in a clear and understandable manner. It was evident that they were well-trained and experienced.

My experience with them exceeded my expectations, and I will definitely be calling on them for any future AC needs. Thank you, Garland Heating and Air, for keeping my home cool and comfortable!

reviews.text: TOO PRICEY! I should have canceled from the get-go. I had scheduled my appointment for Monday morning and when the storm came in,they decided to call Monday an emergency ...then they called and asked me if I had an emergency. I said yes, as I had been without heat for 3 days at that point. So they told me. I would have to pay an emergency fee, not thrilled, especially when the office person told me that money talks. But I needed service. I agreed to pay it.  Unfortunately, the tech got there and decided that he had to up charge me for the thermostat that he placed on the home by $200. Then he could not find the problem. Spent another two hours fumbling around my home doing nothing and charged me an extra one hundred seventy-five dollars on top of the service call upcharge and thermostat up charge  All said and done I paid this guy over 600 hundred dollars and still didn't have heat. I had to call another company the next day. Only to find out that their technician did not set my thermostat for the heat pump, did not put wires back together in the condenser, and that's why it wouldn't run. These people are no better than a chuck in a truck, but they want to charge like they really do something. Save yourself, call someone else.
